topics.commercial: A commercial multi-choir SaaS, independent organizations, not one choir-specific application
topics.both_stores: Complete usable mobile product published in both App Store and Google Play
topics.android_first: Prioritize usable Android beta before full two-store release
topics.rn_expo: Retain React Native/Expo; Flutter only an alternative
topics.preserve_features: Preserve existing web features during mobile migration, including appropriate permanent WebViews
topics.repertoire: Useful repertoire, protected PDFs, annotations, audio and rehearsal experience
topics.annotations_sync: Native annotation writing, stylus/tablet usability, offline use and recoverable synchronization
topics.native_breadth: Native chat, homework and home screen plus remaining feature breadth
topics.tenant_security: Choir-aware roles/memberships and strict tenant isolation; next online request revocation
topics.drive_exit: Move choir files off Drive to private storage, preserve data, maintain working file flows
topics.low_cost: Low recurring infrastructure cost, retain Supabase, avoid unnecessary rewrites
topics.assisted_onboarding: Operator-assisted first-version choir creation; self-service later
topics.pricing: Five free choir members; charge extra members, individual sales deferred
topics.autonomous: Agent makes concrete measurable goals, proceeds autonomously, asks only needed product choices
topics.no_manual_qa: Agent performs Android/iOS UI testing, owner must not perform manual test steps
topics.jev_use: Use Jev broadly for bounded analysis/debugging/search and report measured costs
topics.delivery_focus: Stop excessive tiny checkpoints/rebuilds/approvals; tangible end-to-end product progress
topics.evidence: Verify actual code/tests, distinguish local/mock/runtime/hosted/device/store proof, no invented success
topics.resource_hygiene: Control disk use, clean task-owned generated outputs, preserve user data/caches
topics.sibling_detached: Do not change sibling website; it no longer consumes the application database
topics.preserve_old_notes: Keep old conductor notes/data; withdrawal of permission to delete them
